create_symbolic_shape_env: create a ShapeEnv to manage symbolic tensor dimensions and generate dynamic shape guards
test_produce_guards: test ShapeEnv.produce_guards to generate guard expressions for tensor placeholder inputs
evaluate_symbolic_expr: evaluate a symbolic expression using ShapeEnv.evaluate_expr with optional hints and FX node tracking
constrain_symbol_range: constrain a SymInt symbol to a min-max range using ShapeEnv.constrain_range without guards
unify_symbolic_dimensions: unify two SymInt symbols to be equal using ShapeEnv.constrain_unify for duck sizing
